title: coons_inset_faces radial edge handles: fit cubic bezier from iso-direction tangents
description: Follow-up polish for DSL-42. Today coons_inset_faces sets zero handles on radial edges (outer cage corner to inner surface corner) because the edge traces a diagonal in (u,v) parameter space rather than a clean iso-curve. Zero handles produce straight radial segments, which is fine for typical inset values (t=0.2-0.35) but would curve correctly if we sampled ∂S/∂u + ∂S/∂v at the endpoints and magnitudes at chord/3. Low priority — feature is functional and clean without it — but worth doing for surface fidelity on high-curvature cages.
definition-of-done: 1. Radial edges get tangent-sampled handles. 2. Visible smoother transition in high-curvature render vs current zero-handle version.
testing-plan: 1. Render a coons_inset on a high-curvature cage (weight=1.5). 2. Compare side-quad silhouettes before/after.
